answers.sql: SELECT h1.revenue_million - q2.revenue_million FROM services h1, services q2 WHERE h1.entity='Apple' AND h1.fiscal_year=2024 AND h1.period='H1' AND q2.entity='Apple' AND q2.fiscal_year=2024 AND q2.period='Q2'

SELECT h1.gross_profit_million - q2.gross_profit_million FROM services h1, services q2 WHERE h1.entity='Apple' AND h1.fiscal_year=2024 AND h1.period='H1' AND q2.entity='Apple' AND q2.fiscal_year=2024 AND q2.period='Q2'

SELECT (h1.gross_profit_million - q2.gross_profit_million) * 100.0 / (h1.revenue_million - q2.revenue_million) FROM services h1, services q2 WHERE h1.entity='Apple' AND h1.fiscal_year=2024 AND h1.period='H1' AND q2.entity='Apple' AND q2.fiscal_year=2024 AND q2.period='Q2'

SELECT (q2.gross_profit_million * 100.0 / q2.revenue_million) - ((h1.gross_profit_million - q2.gross_profit_million) * 100.0 / (h1.revenue_million - q2.revenue_million)) FROM services h1, services q2 WHERE h1.entity='Apple' AND h1.fiscal_year=2024 AND h1.period='H1' AND q2.entity='Apple' AND q2.fiscal_year=2024 AND q2.period='Q2'
